title: Why a Toyota 2000GT Costs More Than a New Ferrari
description:
A new Toyota 2000GT went on sale in nineteen sixty-eight for about seven thousand dollars. Today a good one costs more than a brand-new Ferrari Roma, a 296, a Purosangue, a Twelve Cilindri and even the SF90. This video checks that claim number by number, shows what the car costs to buy and to keep alive, and flags every figure we could not find. Our sources are Hagerty's valuation pages, Classic and Sports Car, Sports Car Market, Wikipedia, the car magazine The Manual and the site Supercars dot net for new Ferrari prices, and restoration reports from BusinessDay in South Africa and Toyota's UK magazine. We show conflicts. Our own arithmetic is labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
